intelligence.human_view: Three ways to edit is not indecision — it is 10-star service: the citizen edits the way that occurs to them in the moment, and every way works. Right-click for the one who knows, the little control for the one who sees it, Settings for the one who goes looking. "If we can do it, we do it" is the standard stated as a rule: when the system can offer all three, offering one is holding back. The decision also closes the open question SN-2964 carried honestly — the mechanism was his call, and now it is decided.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you want to change the pictures on your special shelf — and there are THREE ways to do it! You can right-click, or tap the little pencil, or go into Settings! Whichever way you think of first — it works! Because if we can do all three, we do all three!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — when you want to change your top three links, there are three lovely ways to do it: right-click it, dear, or tap the little edit button on it, or change it in the Settings. All three work, whichever you think of first. If we can do it, we do it — that's how you look after people properly.
intelligence.naya_view: Featured links: edit them three ways — right-click, the little edit control, or Settings. All three. If we can do it, we do it.
